# textures

The goal of textures is to utilize texture mapping in rgl to work with
images in different coordinate systems and mapped onto arbitrary shapes.

We aim to illustrate texture mapping capability in rgl with *core
techniques familiar to R users*, and with minimal *resort to specialist
code*. When specialist code is required it will be brought out
explicitly and explained in a single-step.

## Design

Current functions are:

- **png_plot3d()** - plots a PNG file in a 3D scene
- **quad()** create a simple mesh3d object with 1 or more quad
  primitives
- **quad_texture()** create a mesh3d object with 1 or more quads, and
  the texture coordinates and file path to a PNG file
- **set_scene()** a convenience wrapper to rgl scene settings, it makes
  the scene look “straight-down” and locks pan and tilt so the rgl
  device like a zoom-in/zoom-out 2D displays
- **break_mesh()** break the topology of a mesh (so that primitives can
  be free-floating, not tied to their neighbour’s vertices)

See [design
vignette](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/articles/design.html).

## Installation

Install from github, will require development tools for compiling code.

``` r

## install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("hypertidy/textures")
```

## Example

A Mercator raster on a single quad. Zoom in and out but no translate or
pivot.

Maps an image onto a quad from a PNG file. Run this code and zoom in and
out.

``` r

library(textures)
## create a temporary file and write an image to it
tfile <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
png::writePNG(ga_topo$img/255, tfile)

## create a quad *canvas*, a single 4-corner shape floating in 3D
## (and use the PNG file as the material to texture that canvas)
quad0 <- quad_texture(c(1, 1), extent = ga_topo$extent, texture = tfile, )


## plot it in 3D 
rgl::open3d()
rgl::plot3d(quad0, specular = "black")
set_scene()  ## this sets the plot up to appear like a 2D image
```

![texture map on a quad](reference/figures/readme_ga000.png)

texture map on a quad

Maps are fun but R is not just about *geography*.

``` r

library(ggplot2)
library(rgl)
## create a plot and save it
g <- ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, fill = drv)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap(~drv, ncol = 1)
g

tfile <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
ggsave(tfile, g)


library(textures)
quad0 <- quad_texture(dimension = c(92, 102), texture = tfile)

ex <- -20
## flip it (fixme later)
quad0$vb[1L, ] <- 1-quad0$vb[1L, ]
quad0$vb[2L, ] <- 1-quad0$vb[2L, ]

quad0$vb[1L,] <- scales::rescale(quad0$vb[1,], to = c(-1, 1) * ex)
quad0$vb[2L,] <- scales::rescale(quad0$vb[2L,], to = c(-1, 1) * ex)

f <- function(x, y) { r <- sqrt(x^2+y^2); 10 * sin(r)/r }  ## ?persp
quad0$vb[3L, ] <- f(quad0$vb[1L,], quad0$vb[2L,])

## not working atm ...
#quad0 <- addNormals(quad0)  ## we are still in rgl scope, so everything is available
## plot it in 3D 
rgl::open3d()
rgl::plot3d(quad0, specular = "black")
rgl::aspect3d(1, 1, .3)
#set_scene(phi = 15, interactive = TRUE)
par3d(windowRect  = c(0, 0, 1024, 1024))
```

![texture map on a quad](reference/figures/readme_gg000.png)

texture map on a quad

# Package index

## Compact specification

The recipe for a generatable mesh, nothing materialized

- [`quad_spec()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/quad_spec.md)
  [`quad_mesh()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/quad_spec.md)
  [`as.mesh3d(`*`<quad_spec>`*`)`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/quad_spec.md)
  [`print(`*`<quad_spec>`*`)`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/quad_spec.md)
  : Compact quad mesh specification

## Mesh primitives

Index, edges (unexpanded), and vertices from dimension and extent

- [`quad_index()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/quad_index.md)
  [`quad_edges()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/quad_index.md)
  [`quad_vertex()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/quad_index.md)
  : Quad mesh primitives

## Mesh objects

- [`quad()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/quad.md)
  [`quad_texture()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/quad.md)
  [`segs()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/quad.md) :
  Quad mesh objects
- [`break_mesh()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/break_mesh.md)
  : Break mesh, expand vertex instances

## Plotting

- [`plot(`*`<mesh3d>`*`)`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/plot.mesh3d.md)
  : Plot (2D) for mesh3d
- [`png_plot3d()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/png_plot3d.md)
  : Plot a PNG bitmap in 3D
- [`set_scene()`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/set_scene.md)
  : rgl defaults

## Data

- [`ga_topo`](https://hypertidy.github.io/textures/reference/ga_topo.md)
  : Topographic image
